_comment: PLACEHOLDER priors for tools/kaeres/sched.py (--sched return), to be fitted by tools/research/effort/replay.py. Per action type and incumbent-opens bucket: per_cpu_h = prior opens closed per CPU-hour, b0_s = prior CPU seconds (pseudo-count); a0 = per_cpu_h * b0_s / 3600. Starting values from s2-merit213: resumed attempts removed about 4x more opens per CPU-hour than fresh ones.
